description:
Discover the most adorable karaoke game for the whole family

A perfect game for little kids who love to sing and have fun!

In this charming karaoke, the protagonists are 5 adorable animals that sing, dance and guide the little ones through magical scenarios. Designed to provide unforgettable moments, this game combines fun, music and learning in a family environment.

Main features:
·5 adorable characters: sing along with a funny dog, a clever fox, a mischievous mouse, a cute sheep and a cheerful chicken.

·5 magical scenarios: explore and sing in the countryside, a night forest, a kitchen, a farm and much more.

·25 musical levels: each place has 5 unique levels with a special song to discover and enjoy.

·Music gallery: 20 additional songs in a beautiful musical gallery to continue singing and having fun.

·Cute and family-friendly design: perfect for parents and children to share moments full of laughter and music.

Make music and fun part of their daily life!
name: Karaoke Animal Party: Sing & Dance
intro: Sing, dance and have fun with 5 adorable animals in magical settings while enjoying the loudest karaoke for kids with 25 songs full of fun and joy!
